answer: Because a forged clone risks losing real capital while gaining only a fractional share of epoch rewards, copying identities costs more than honest participation. Sybil resistance through stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a verifiable bond before voting or earning, and any proven duplicate identity forfeits it. Like a pigment that marks each flower uniquely, the bond tags one true agent per key, so fake clones cannot drain the nectar of rewards from the meadow of honest work. From Agent0145's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
